info.title: Thruk
info.description: Thruk is a web interface and monitoring dashboard for Naemon/Nagios-compatible monitoring cores, exposing hosts, services, groups, downtimes, comments, and monitoring core configuration over a REST API. Authentication: static API key (X-Thruk-Auth-Key header, optionally paired with X-Thruk-Auth-User for a superuser key acting on behalf of another user).
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 73 of 169 upstream operations covering hosts, services, host/service groups, contacts/contactgroups, downtimes, comments, commands and timeperiods (read + external-command actions), status/statistics listings, sites, and the config save/check/reload/revert lifecycle needed to persist host/service config changes. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

servers.description: Thruk REST API server. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/thruk/r" (a standalone install), or "/<omd-site>/thruk/r" if Thruk runs under OMD (e.g. "/monitoring/thruk/r").

host.description: Thruk server hostname or IP (no protocol, no path).

apiKeyAuth.name: X-Thruk-Auth-Key
apiKeyAuth.description: Static, user-generated Thruk API key. Superuser keys can additionally set the acting user via the X-Thruk-Auth-User header.

post.summary: Run an external command against a contactgroup
post.description: Sends one of the documented external commands (acknowledge, schedule/remove downtime, comment, enable/disable checks or notifications, etc.) to a contactgroup.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: External command to run against the contactgroup. See the Thruk REST API commands reference for the per-command parameters.

author.description: Author name attributed to the command.

sticky.description: For acknowledgements: keep the acknowledgement until the host/service fully recovers.

notify.description: Whether to send a notification for this command.

persistent.description: Whether the comment/acknowledgement survives program restarts.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp (or relative time expression) the action starts.

end_time.description: Unix timestamp (or relative time expression) the action ends.

fixed.description: Whether a downtime is fixed (1) or flexible (0).

duration.description: Duration in seconds, used for flexible downtimes.

trigger_id.description: Downtime ID that triggers this one, 0 for non-triggered.

downtime_id.description: ID of the downtime to remove.

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to remove.

value.description: New value for change_* commands (variable value, timeperiod name, interval, etc.).

variable.description: Name of the custom variable to change (change_custom_*_var commands).

check_command.description: Command line for passive check result submission.

check_output.description: Plugin output for passive check result submission.

return_code.description: Return code for passive check result submission (0-3).

notification_number.description: New notification number for set_*_notification_number commands.
